reason: The repository is a DeepSeek Harness plugin centered on coordinating multi-agent task execution: the lead creates DAG-based plans, dispatches nodes, and reviews results, while members execute tasks and a reconciler/runtime loop keeps progress moving across restarts. Evidence shows task truth stored in an append-only workspace log with snapshot/inbox views and UI/status surfaces, so the primary user-facing purpose is orchestration and planning execution rather than generic coding or file-only tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向长任务的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于让 lead 规划依赖任务图并协调成员执行与复核，并通过持久化日志和看板持续跟踪任务运行状态。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for coordinating multi-agent long tasks where a lead plans dependencies, dispatches and reviews node work, and tracks progress through persisted task logs plus board/status views.

capabilities: Review-gated dependency dispatch and completion flow
Persistent task and event storage in workspace directory
Resident reconciliation to resume interrupted work
User-facing task board and status inspection routes
